main_text.head: IDEM MOSIS CANTICVM, POETICA PARAPHRASI AB initio ad finem usque, heroicis versibus expressum.
main_text.p: AVdiat hæc Tellus, hæc audiat arduus Æ-ther, Quæ fari incipiam, dulcíque referre Camœna. Nunc mihi rore leni, nunc blando mollius imbre Verba fluant, quales nimio sitientibus æstu Infidunt herbis, & luxuriantia mulcent Gramina cæruleis pluuiâ de nubibus ortâ. Námque Deum celebrabo: Deum celebrate volucres Vna omnes pasim, pietas quibus aurea cordi est. Integra sunt quæcunque gerit, nihil ille beata Mente agitat, quod non iusto, non congruat æquo. Et seruare fidem, scelerum purissimus unus Nouit & amplecti quicquid rectúmque piumq; est. Sed tamen (ô cæcas mentes!) desciuit ab illo Degener immerito populus, iam prava, nocensque Natio, nec tanti censenda fauore parentis.

Ah Popule insipiens, quæ te dementia vertit? His meritum officiis cumulas? hæc præmia soluis? Nonne tuus Pater est, cuius tu munere spiras? Nonne tuus Dominus, qui te suscepit & omnes Vnum inter populos proprie sibi legit habendum?

page.notes: The title line "POETICA PARAPHRASI AB" is set in small capitals; the printed letters are reproduced as seen. "piumq;" is followed by a small superscript mark that may be a reference or an abbreviation stroke; it is copied as "piumq;" without a reference. "pasim" is printed as seen and may be a printer's variant of "passim". The sentence-level punctuation of the verse is copied as printed. The large initial A is joined to "Vdiat" as "AVdiat".
